questions.question: In a right-angled triangle, $\sin\theta$ is defined as:
Which side of a right-angled triangle NEVER changes its label, regardless of which acute angle you choose?
options: The hypotenuse — always opposite the right angle

questions.question: Why is $\sin 30°$ the same number in every right-angled triangle containing a 30° angle?
options: Similar triangles keep side ratios identical regardless of the triangle's size
It is only the same for triangles of equal area
It is a coincidence of the number 30

subtopics.title: Finding the Angle — the Inverse Move

questions.question: Hypotenuse 13, side opposite x is 5. The correct ratio equation is:
To find the angle from $\sin x = \frac{5}{13}$, you use:
Which sense check supports $x \approx 22{,}6°$?
options: All angles in trigonometry are below 30°
$\frac{5}{13}$ is less than $\frac{1}{2}$, and $\sin 30° = \frac{1}{2}$, so the angle must be below 30°
The angle must equal half the hypotenuse

questions.question: The third side of the 5-13 triangle is 12. The other acute angle is approximately:
options: $67{,}4°$, since the two acute angles must sum to $90°$

subtopics.title: Choosing the Right Ratio — and the Complete Method

questions.question: Known: opposite = 5 and adjacent = 12. Which ratio finds the angle?
Your calculator says $\sin 30° = -0{,}988$. The most likely cause is:
options: The angle is too small for the calculator
The calculator is in radian mode instead of degree mode

questions.question: Why must you label opposite and adjacent only AFTER choosing which angle you are working with?
options: The two labels swap places when you switch to the other acute angle
The hypotenuse changes with the angle

questions.question: When do you use the INVERSE trig function?
options: When the angle is known and a side is wanted
When the ratio of sides is known and the angle is wanted

subtopics.title: Where You Stand Decides the Names

questions.question: In the ladder picture, which side is the hypotenuse?
options: The ladder itself — the slanted side lying across from the square corner

questions.question: You move from the angle at the foot of the ladder to the angle at the top. What changes?
options: The opposite and adjacent sides swap; the ladder stays the hypotenuse
The right angle moves to the top

questions.question: Which ratio pairs the OPPOSITE side with the ADJACENT side?
options: Neither — that pair is never used

questions.question: A long ladder and a short ladder lean at the same slant. Why is $\sin\theta$ the same for both?
options: Because both ladders touch the same wall
Because a ratio compares sides, so 5 over 13 and 10 over 26 are the same value

Which 'gear' finds an ANGLE when two sides are known?
options: Forward gear — the plain sine, cosine or tangent
Reverse gear — the inverse function (shift then sine)

questions.question: The ladder's foot stands 12 m from the wall. The angle at the TOP of the ladder is about:
options: 67,4°, because the two acute angles must add to 90°

questions.question: Your calculator returns $\sin 30° = -0{,}988$. What do you fix?
options: Switch it from radian mode back to degree mode and look for the D on the screen
